evidence_items.claim: Société Générale joined FINOS as a Gold member in May 2022
evidence_items.excerpt: Société Générale (SocGen), a French multinational investment bank and financial services company, joins FINOS as a Gold member.
evidence_items.caveats: FINOS membership does not confirm CDM-specific adoption.

evidence_items.claim: Société Générale implemented 'Open Source First' policy in 2017 and established OSPO in 2020
evidence_items.excerpt: Société Générale implemented an 'Open Source First' policy in 2017 and established its Open Source Program office (OSPO) in 2020.
evidence_items.caveats: Open source focus is infrastructure (PostgreSQL), not CDM/derivatives.

evidence_items.claim: Société Générale participated in FINOS Common Cloud Controls (CCC) formation
evidence_items.excerpt: Société Générale is among the member organizations that have participated in FINOS CCC's formation and definition phase.
evidence_items.caveats: CCC is cloud/cybersecurity focused, NOT CDM/derivatives focused.

evidence_items.claim: Risk.net named Société Générale Derivatives Client Clearer of Year 2024
evidence_items.excerpt: Societe Generale's edge comes from a post-trade platform and clearing capability expansion.
evidence_items.caveats: Derivatives clearing capability without CDM specificity.
